items.headline: Manchester United sign Liverpool youngster Isaac Konde
items.summary: Manchester United announce signing of 16-year-old winger Isaac Konde from Liverpool. Konde featured regularly for Liverpool's under-18.

items.headline: Patrick Dorgu returns to Manchester with thigh injury from Denmark duty
items.summary: Patrick Dorgu withdrawn from Denmark squad after sustaining thigh injury in Nations League match against Wales. Returning to club for assessment.

items.headline: Bruno Fernandes remains with Portugal squad despite fitness doubts
items.summary: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes omitted from Norway match as precaution but stays with Portugal. Expected to return for Thursday fixture.

items.headline: Noussair Mazraoui forced off during Morocco international match
items.summary: Noussair Mazraoui withdrawn in 69th minute after apparent injury landing awkwardly while winning ball during Morocco's 2-0 win over Lesotho.

items.headline: Matthijs de Ligt still sidelined by back injury, imminent return expected
items.summary: Dutch centre-back has been out for almost 10 months with ongoing back injury. Yet to feature under Michael Carrick but expected return before Christmas.
